executed_proofs.proves: A customer quotes, holds both windows, books an order, gets an invoice and pays with the fake provider; the price comes from the server.

executed_proofs.area: Evidence object scope (order / claim / custody_event) and privacy
executed_proofs.proves: A customer cannot list or read another customer's claim or custody evidence, a partner cannot read an unassigned order's evidence, another tenant is denied, and the storage key never leaves the service.

executed_proofs.area: CSRF / origin enforcement on cookie-authenticated state changes
executed_proofs.proves: DELETE, POST and other unsafe methods reject a cross-site Origin, while same-origin and originless clients are allowed.

executed_proofs.area: Money invariants — a voided invoice must never be captured
executed_proofs.proves: A cancelled invoice is refused with FINANCIAL_HOLD and creates no payment intent, while an open invoice is captured exactly once.
GET /finance/overview returns the tenant aggregate, refuses a customer, hides another tenant's rows and refuses an unauthenticated call.

executed_proofs.area: Document rendering and the non-fiscal warning
executed_proofs.proves: GET /documents/:kind/:id is object scoped, refuses a forbidden role and carries an explicit 'not a 54-FZ fiscal receipt' disclaimer.
The order returns unprocessed, the customer is never charged, the held capacity is released, and a partner that is not assigned to the order sees nothing.

executed_proofs.area: Phone OTP (fake provider) and preview unlock
executed_proofs.proves: Only a hash of the code is stored, the surface does not exist in production, attempts are bounded, the preview role allowlist is server side and every attempt is audited.
Suspending a member revokes its sessions, another tenant is hidden, the last active administrator cannot be suspended away, and self-suspension is refused.

executed_proofs.area: Repository hygiene — no database bytes, secrets, media or oversized blobs tracked
executed_proofs.proves: The guard exits non-zero on a planted PostgreSQL cluster, a secret, media and an oversized blob, and prints only paths, never contents.
